name: Summoning the Princess
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
You must defeat Myzrael before she grows in strength.  If you do not, then once she has gathered enough power she will challenge her captors!  There are some who think they can control her, but if she can be controlled then why did the giants chain her in the first place??

Crazy logic, eh?

To defeat her, summon her at the Shards of Myzrael where you first spoke with her.  Defeat her and gather her Eldritch Shackles, then bind them to the Shards of Myzrael.

Do that, and she will again be trapped.
narrative.objectives:
Go to the Shards of Myzrael, summon her and defeat her.

Gather her Eldritch Shackles and bind them to the Shards of Myzrael.
narrative.offerRewardText:
As the eldritch shackles are placed around the Shards, an unhuman wail is heard from far below. The scream is followed by a roar.

The Shards of Myzrael no longer invoke feelings of warmth and security as they once did. Now they pulse with an open menace... as if the thing beneath them holds ill will toward the surface.
narrative.requestItemsText: The Shards of Myzrael are now strangely quiet.

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 37 to 50, 25,800 XP in all.

quests.name: The Princess Trapped
quests.objectiveText: Gather 12 Motes of Myzrael, then bring them to the Iridescent Shards in Drywhisker Gorge.

quests.name: Stones of Binding
quests.objectiveText: Gather the Burning Key, the Cresting Key and the Thundering Key from the Stone of West Binding, the Stone of East Binding and the Stone of Outer Binding. Bring them to the Stone

quests.name: Myzrael's Allies
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Gerrig Bonegrip in the Forlorn Cavern of Ironforge.

quests.name: The Lost Fragments
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Torn Scroll Fragment, the Crumpled Scroll Fragment and the Singed Scroll Fragment to Theldurin the Lost.

quests.name: Summoning the Princess
quests.objectiveText: Go to the Shards of Myzrael, summon her and defeat her. Gather her Eldritch Shackles and bind them to the Shards of Myzrael.
